title: PayPal shares sink on reported collapse of Stripe-Advent takeover deal
text: Shares in PayPal plummeted more than 13% on Friday on reports that Stripe and Advent International have pulled out of their takeover bid for the payments giant.

title: Visa and Mastercard complete transactions in Syria after US lifts state terrorism label
text: Visa and Mastercard have completed their first international card transactions in Syria after the US removed it from the state sponsors of terrorism list.

title: RQD* Clearing raises $74 million

title: Swift accepts request to extend structured address migration for ISO 20022 messages
text: Swift is extending the November deadline for moving from unstructured to structured postal addresses for ISO 20022 payment messages after a host of banks asked for more time to comply.

title: Socure hits $5.2bn valuation on investment; buys AI fraud platform Fravity
text: Socure, the identity and risk intelligence infrastructure platform, has raised funding from investors including Goldman Sachs Alternatives and Wells Fargo at a $5.2 billion valuation. The firm has also acquired Fravity, an agentic platform that automates fraud, risk, and compliance operations.

title: US state bankers associations to build industry-owned blockchain network
